mentions.name: 1BRC solution video/post
mentions.description: This video/post explains how to solve the 1 billion row challenge (1BRC) and achieve a competitively fast result while keeping the code readable, maintainable, and modularized. It reaches near-winning performance without unsafe code, bit-twiddling tricks, or custom JVMs.
mentions.problem: Solving the 1 billion row challenge fast without sacrificing code readability, maintainability, or clean separation of concerns.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a video / post on how to solve the 1 billion row challenge (https://github.com/gunnarmorling/1brc) and get a competitively fast result while keeping the code readable and maintainable.
